summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Survey System for Backyard Ultra Santo Domingo 2026. All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified survey page with 3 tabs, form submission flow, navigation links, footer links, admin login 'Volver al Home' link, and admin panel survey results section.
critical_code_review_comments: Survey endpoints correctly validate rating fields (1-5 range) using Pydantic Field constraints
MongoDB _id is properly excluded from responses using projection {'_id': 0}
Survey stats endpoint correctly aggregates counts from all 3 collections
Frontend forms have proper client-side validation before submission
Admin panel SurveyResultsSection correctly displays stats, tabs, and individual responses
seed_data_creation: Created test survey submissions during testing: 4 athlete surveys, 2 volunteer surveys, 2 spectator surveys
context_for_next_testing_agent: Survey system fully functional. Endpoints: POST /api/surveys/athletes, /volunteers, /spectators for submissions. GET /api/surveys/stats for counts. GET /api/surveys/{type}/responses for admin view. Frontend: /encuesta page with 3 tabs (data-testid='tab-athletes', 'tab-volunteers', 'tab-spectators'). Admin panel shows 'Resultados de Encuestas' section with stats and expandable responses.

volunteers_survey_form.evidence: API test passed - POST returns 200 with success:true
